reviewContext.increment: G1.1-A2 (external-inflow / finalized block-cursor model, INV-7) — sprint-7 hardening fixes re-review
reviewContext.coreQuestion: Can the earner write a USDC number that did not come from a genuine, FINALIZED, external on-chain payment?
reviewContext.coreAnswer: NO. (1) On the prod path (FOUNDER_TEST unset, record-earn.mjs:14) every override seam is TEST-gated: FOUNDER_DIR (20), FOUNDER_LEDGER (24), FOUNDER_WALLET (38), FOUNDER_CURSOR (109), FOUNDER_BLOCK_NOW (63), FOUNDER_LOGS_JSON (89), FOUNDER_RAW_LOGS_JSON (91), BASE_RPC_URL (56), HOME (20). (2) Prod root is an env-independent absolute literal '/Users/operator/.anicca-founder' (20). (3) The wallet is pinned to 0x810f and shared/automaton/openclaw wallets are rejected (35-42). (4) blockNow() reads ONLY the FINALIZED head (67) so the cursor never advances past genuinely settled income — no reorg over/double-count. (5) The scan is bounded (cursor+1..to] with to=min(now,cursor+MAX_SPAN) (122,124) and the cursor is advanced only to what was scanned (125) — under-count on a wide gap, never over-count. (6) parseRawLogs locally RE-verifies address==USDC, topic0==Transfer, and to==founder by EXACT padded-topic equality (83-84), and sumExternal drops any from in MY_WALLETS (74) — a self-transfer contributes ZERO (INV-7). (7) Every error path fails closed: corrupt cursor (111), missing wallet.json (39), missing founder dir (28), block-backwards (117), RPC/getLogs failure (113,124), malformed data BigInt throw (85 -> 124 catch die). No combination on the prod path writes a fabricated or inflated USDC number.

newDefects.FIND-801: ADVISORY (non-blocking, liveness not integrity): with MAX_SPAN=9000 (record-earn.mjs:121-122) and Base producing ~43,200 blocks/day (~2s/block), if the loop wakes less often than ~once per 5h the cursor falls >9000 behind and never catches up, permanently lagging real income. This is under-count / monotonic / fail-safe — it can NEVER fabricate or inflate a USDC number, so it does not fail the core integrity question or any dimension. Recommended (future increment, not a sprint-8 blocker): loop getLogs in <=MAX_SPAN windows up to `now` within one run, summing, advancing the cursor per completed window, so a wide gap after downtime still settles.
